caveat: A browsable stand-in for the production extra-trees forest, not the forest itself. It reproduces the console's figure for most plates and drifts on the rest; the fidelity block says by how much.

target.name: typical closing price of the plate

input.number: 1-4 digit characters; leading zeros stripped; value 0 is not a plate
input.letters: 1-3 Latin letters from ABDEGHJKLNRSTUVXZ; Arabic letters map through arabic_to_latin

indexing.value: v = int(number without leading zeros), clamped to 1..9999
indexing.shape: ((((letter_count-1)*2 + repeated)*2 + all_letters_same)*2 + letters_ascending)*2 + spells_known_word; letter_count capped at 3
